system.description:
You manifest lightning until it covering the body of an allied creature that is not yourself. The target creature is engulfed in a raging torrent of lightning. For this duration, damage they deal adds an additional 2d8 lightning damage, twice per turn. They also gain resistance to Earth and Lightning damage and a +20 bonus to their speed.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of targets this jutsu can affect by +1.
